text: {"features":[{"name":"Role motivation","description":"How clearly and convincingly the letter explains why the applicant wants this specific role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Expresses interest in the job in generic application language without explaining why this particular role is appealing."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Gives one broad reason for applying, such as liking security or large companies, but provides little sense of personal fit."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Explains a clear role-relevant reason for applying, though the rationale remains fairly general."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Links the role to a coherent career direction, personal belief, or prior experience that makes the move feel well grounded."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Builds a specific and memorable case for wanting this exact role now by tightly connecting past work, future goals, and the team's mission."}]},{"name":"Mission insight","description":"How well the letter shows understanding of the problems this team is trying to solve.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows little understanding of the team's actual work beyond that it is a security engineering role."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"References one obvious duty or keyword from the job description but does not show a fuller grasp of the problem space."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Recognizes that the role centers on security tooling or vulnerability response at scale, but the explanation remains surface-level."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Accurately describes several parts of the mission, such as lifecycle security, vulnerability handling, or AI-enabled tooling."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows deep understanding of the role as a systems problem of scaling security expertise through automation, agentic tooling, and developer support."}]},{"name":"Platform mindset","description":"The extent to which the applicant values foundational work whose effects compound across many teams or products.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Focuses on the role in narrow or generic terms without mentioning broad organizational leverage."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Makes a brief general statement about large-scale impact but does not develop it."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows interest in foundational or core systems that help many users or teams."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explicitly emphasizes multiplier effects, central platforms, or the value of improvements inherited across an organization."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes platform leverage a central theme and shows sophisticated appreciation for how automation or infrastructure compounds security impact company-wide."}]},{"name":"Developer enablement","description":"How strongly the letter frames security as helping developers build securely rather than merely policing them.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Treats security as standalone defensive work with no attention to the developers who will use or benefit from the tooling."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Hints at supporting other teams but does not clearly discuss developer workflows, usability, or secure defaults."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mentions making security easier for engineers or helping product teams work more safely."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly emphasizes enabling busy developers through secure defaults, usable tooling, or close proximity to the teams served."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents developer enablement as a core philosophy, explicitly centering secure-by-default workflows and supportive partnership over after-the-fact policing."}]},{"name":"Security collaboration","description":"How well the letter signals readiness to partner closely with security specialists and adjacent teams.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention collaboration with security specialists or partner teams in any role-relevant way."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Uses generic team-player language but gives no concrete picture of role-relevant collaboration."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows willingness to work with security or product teams as part of the role."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explicitly describes working alongside security engineers or building tools in close contact with the teams they serve."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes cross-disciplinary partnership central to the application, showing respect for specialist expertise and a clear model for combining software engineering with security practice."}]},{"name":"Software engineering depth","description":"Depth of relevant professional experience testing, maintaining, and launching production software.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Presents only near-threshold production experience, with limited evidence of repeated ownership across launched systems."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows early-career production experience with some testing, maintenance, and launch responsibility but modest breadth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows solid professional depth through several years of work across multiple production services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong depth through extensive ownership or repeated launches across several production systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows standout depth, combining longer tenure with broad lifecycle responsibility across many production services."}]},{"name":"Go fluency","description":"Strength of evidence that the applicant can design and implement Go back-end systems for this role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Names Go as part of the background but gives no real evidence of depth or relevant systems built with it."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Identifies Go as a main language yet provides only thin evidence of what was implemented in it."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Makes clear that Go is used regularly for production services or back-end work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Connects Go experience to concrete infrastructure or back-end systems relevant to the role."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Uses specific examples to show expert, role-aligned Go work in constrained, auditable, or large-scale back-end systems."}]},{"name":"Python fluency","description":"Strength of evidence that the applicant can use Python for tooling, services, and AI-agent work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention Python or provides no credible signal of real use."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions Python briefly but without scope, quality, or production context."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular Python use for tooling, automation, prototypes, or internal services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows substantial Python ownership in production services, internal tools, or automation layers."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Portrays Python as production-grade and central to the applicant's work, with clear signs of disciplined implementation or extensible tooling."}]},{"name":"AI systems experience","description":"Strength of evidence of building or shipping AI-enabled functionality relevant to the role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of AI work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions AI interest or exposure but not real implementation experience."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States that the applicant has built or shipped AI or LLM-backed functionality in production."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows practical AI experience plus awareness of reliability, evaluation, or failure modes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents substantial production AI experience grounded in controls, evaluation, and sound judgment about where models are and are not dependable."}]},{"name":"Agentic design","description":"Strength of evidence of designing agent-based systems with clear roles, constraints, and infrastructure.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of agentic systems work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions agents or automation in vague terms without architecture or ownership details."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States that the applicant has built agentic workflows or pipelines with Go and Python components."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes how agents decompose tasks and how surrounding services constrain, supervise, or audit them."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Gives a clear, technically credible picture of architecting agentic systems with bounded autonomy, auditable actions, and deliberate guardrails."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability automation","description":"Strength of evidence of automating vulnerability intake, triage, routing, or related response workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Offers no experience with vulnerability handling automation."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions security automation generally but not vulnerability workflows specifically."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States involvement in automating vulnerability reports or queue handling in broad terms."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes concrete triage mechanics such as classification, deduplication, routing, prioritization, or reduced manual handling."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows end-to-end ownership of a vulnerability automation pipeline and explains clear operational benefits such as expert time returned or substantial manual toil eliminated."}]},{"name":"Security assessment rigor","description":"Strength of evidence of performing structured security assessments and following findings through.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of performing security assessments."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Suggests light exposure to reviews or security work but without clear hands-on assessment responsibility."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States that the applicant has performed security assessments or reviews in general terms."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes structured assessment work such as threat modeling, attack-surface analysis, code review, or validation of fixes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents security assessment as repeated, hands-on engineering work carried out with a clear methodology and attacker-aware reasoning through remediation."}]},{"name":"Algorithms strength","description":"Strength of evidence of data structures and algorithms ability relevant to production systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of algorithmic skill."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims familiarity with algorithms or data structures but offers no concrete application."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides one believable example of using algorithmic thinking to improve a system."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong practical command through specific redesigns of hot paths, scheduling, deduplication, matching, graphs, or streaming computation."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes algorithmic problem-solving a clear strength, with concrete examples showing that better structure choice materially changed system tractability or performance."}]},{"name":"Security credibility","description":"Strength of independent signals that the applicant has cultivated security skill beyond ordinary software development.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no independent security signal beyond general interest."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Offers a modest signal such as a basic security certification or casual competition mention."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a meaningful but limited signal, such as regular CTF participation or a practical certification without much further evidence."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Offers one strong hands-on signal, such as a rigorous practical certification or sustained high-level offensive practice."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Combines multiple strong signals of hands-on security capability, such as rigorous certification plus serious competitive or practical attacker-oriented work."}]},{"name":"Engineering rigor","description":"The extent to which the letter signals disciplined practices for correctness, testing, reliability, and operational safety.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Describes work only at a high level and gives no indication of disciplined engineering practices."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Implies care or a maintainer mindset but without concrete rigor signals."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mentions at least one concrete rigor signal such as testing, typing, evaluation, logging, contracts, or failure recovery."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows repeated attention to correctness and boundaries through practices like typed services, explicit contracts, audits, evaluations, or recovery design."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes rigor a defining trait of the applicant's work, with multiple concrete signals that systems are deliberately built to be dependable, bounded, and maintainable."}]},{"name":"Achievement impact","description":"How clearly the letter shows that the applicant's work changed outcomes for a team, system, or workflow.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Lists duties or technologies without any stated effect."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Implies benefit but leaves outcomes vague."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States a clear positive result such as reduced manual work or improved performance."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Ties multiple examples to concrete operational benefits, team time saved, reliability gains, or bugs eliminated."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Repeatedly translates technical work into organizational outcomes, making impact on capacity, speed, or trust unmistakable."}]},{"name":"Example specificity","description":"How concrete and technically detailed the evidence is throughout the letter.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mainly on generic claims and abstract self-description."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Provides a few examples but with thin detail about what was built or how it worked."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Includes several specific examples of systems, tasks, or technical problems."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Uses concrete mechanisms, architectures, or problem types to substantiate claims across the letter."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Consistently backs claims with crisp, technically informative details that make the work easy to picture and highly credible."}]},{"name":"Open-source stewardship","description":"Strength of evidence of contributing to or maintaining open-source software in a substantive way.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no open-source signal."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions occasional patches or general engagement with open source but little ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes recurring upstream fixes or modest ongoing contribution."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows meaningful stewardship such as maintaining a project, reviewing contributions, or cutting releases."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents substantial open-source ownership with an active user community or sustained responsibility for project quality and releases."}]},{"name":"Self-directed projects","description":"Strength of evidence of building substantial projects outside assigned work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no personal project evidence."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a small side project with little technical ambition or detail."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows steady self-directed building through a modest but complete personal tool or application."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes a technically ambitious personal project with meaningful systems concerns."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents a substantial self-directed system chosen to tackle hard engineering problems such as distribution, consistency, failover, recovery, or delivery guarantees."}]},{"name":"Organization","description":"How well the letter is structured, paced, and easy to follow from opening to close.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Feels list-like, disjointed, or hard to track as an argument."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has a basic structure but weak transitions or abrupt shifts between points."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Follows a clear progression with understandable sections and a coherent overall case."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is well organized, with each paragraph advancing the application in a logical sequence."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is exceptionally well shaped, using an effective opening, smooth progression, and strong closure to build a cohesive case."}]},{"name":"Writing mechanics","description":"Quality of spelling, grammar, and sentence-level polish.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Contains frequent distracting spelling or typographical errors that noticeably weaken credibility."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Contains several visible errors or awkward phrasings that interrupt flow."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Has a few minor errors but remains generally clean and professional."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is nearly error-free and reads smoothly."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is fully polished at the sentence level, with clean mechanics and consistently professional phrasing."}]},{"name":"Persuasiveness","description":"How engaging and convincing the prose is beyond the raw list of qualifications.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Reads as bland, template-like, or purely administrative prose that does little to differentiate the candidate."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Is competent but flat, with limited conviction or memorability."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Makes a clear and professional case that is reasonably convincing."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Uses an engaging and confident voice that strengthens the candidate's fit."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Delivers memorable, distinctive prose that makes the application compelling even before considering the resume."}]}]}
